verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke's locations page lists its own offices across many countries: Germany (5), UK (3), Italy (3), Spain (3), US (2), plus Singapore and China. The EC/VC team also describes 'multi-jurisdictional support that helps our clients scale', and the firm offers both UK and DE cap table versions. Together this shows a founder can expand across jurisdictions without engaging a second firm. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the office footprint, and clarity on whether every listed location is a fully integrated office rather than an associated practice (India, for example, is served through regular trips, not an office).
